verses.english: “There are two conditions for the arising of wrong view.

verses.pali: Parato ca ghoso ayoniso ca manasikāro.
verses.english: The voice of another and irrational application of mind.

verses.pali: Ime kho, bhikkhave, dve paccayā micchādiṭṭhiyā uppādāyā”ti.
verses.english: These are the two conditions for the arising of wrong view.”
